degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Management

description.text: Teaching Objectives To learn the basic theory and knowledge in the field of accounting, auditing and business administration and get trained in the basic skills in accounting and auditing. Expected to have reasonable strong ability to analyze and solve problems in accounting and auditing field.Major Courses Management Accounting and AuditingFinancial ManagementMoney and Banking (Provincial Quality Courses)Management ScienceMicro-economicsMacro-economicsInformation Management SystemFinancial AccountingCost AccountingInternship They will be qualified upon graduation for auditing jobs in certified accountant offices both at home and abroad.Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in ManagementFuture Career In commercial enterprises as accountant and financial affairs executive.

duration.text: The Accounting at Shenyang Unversity is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.5. Sponsorship Certificate

requirements.text: 1. Under the age of 352. A high school graduate or with equivalent qualification3. Able to take courses in Chinese (passing the 3th level HSK), or to major in Aeronautical Engineering, International Economics and Trade, Telecomunications Engineering or Mechanical Engineering (taught at SAU in the English medium)
